candidates.title: Prediction-market prior versus official confirmation
candidates.hypothesis: For an independently mapped official event, a timestamp-safe official confirmation that implies a materially higher state probability than the still-observed prediction-market prior creates H5-H20 equity repricing after the confirmation clock.

market_prior.provenance: Frozen market identifier and quoted probability are required per observation.

independent_evidence.provenance: Timestamped official filing or release; no market return fields.

expectation_gap.gap_definition: Frozen calibrated state probability minus the contemporaneous direct implied probability.

transmission.catalyst: Official confirmation becomes public after the frozen market-prior timestamp.

candidates.why_not_arbitraged: The edge, if any, depends on point-in-time entity exposure mapping and distinct probability shocks rather than on generic event sentiment.
candidates.falsifier: No usable issuer overlap, no independent probability shock, or no monotone replacement value after exact timestamp alignment falsifies the mechanism.

baseline.policy: Do not admit candidates from this event-state mapping.

treatment.policy: Admit only predeclared issuer mappings whose independent official state implies a calibrated probability gap after the recorded prior timestamp.

candidates.replacement_value_comparator: Cash, SPY, QQQ, and the displaced core candidate under identical capital constraints.

execution_envelope.borrow_dependency: none for long mapping; any short mapping is a separate hypothesis
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: no earlier than next tradable session after both timestamps

prediction.confidence_reason: The prior is observable, but event independence, exposure mapping, and reopen counts are not ready.

candidates.reopen_condition: Meet the registered prediction-market post-repair count and prove at least 10 independent official-event issuer overlaps under one frozen map.
candidates.next_machine_action: Do not reserve an experiment; cluster distinct probability shocks and audit the registered reopen condition.

candidates.title: Consensus revision versus positioning disagreement
candidates.hypothesis: A large timestamp-safe analyst-consensus revision that is not yet corroborated by persistent Moomoo main-flow positioning identifies either a delayed confirmation trade or an avoid signal, with direction fixed before any return is read.

market_prior.provenance: Frozen same-event analyst estimate and revision timestamps.

independent_evidence.provenance: Archived DAY rows with honest vendor_asof; raw rows are not independent decisions.

expectation_gap.gap_definition: Predeclared sign and magnitude disagreement between explicit consensus revision and normalized positioning confirmation.

transmission.catalyst: Next earnings release or guidance update resolves the consensus-positioning disagreement.

candidates.why_not_arbitraged: Consensus and broker flow have different clocks and coverage; a usable gap requires honest as-of alignment and cash-conflict accounting.
candidates.falsifier: The sign mapping fails a predeclared placebo, candidate overlap stays below 20 independent decisions, or costs erase the conditional spread.

baseline.policy: Use the existing core ranking without consensus-flow disagreement.

treatment.policy: Apply one frozen ranking or avoidance response to the predeclared consensus-flow disagreement state.

candidates.replacement_value_comparator: The displaced eligible core candidate plus cash, SPY, and QQQ.

execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: same eligible-universe liquidity floor as baseline
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: canonical cash-equity costs plus turnover accounting
execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: default-off paper cap and one decision per issuer clock
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: next session after both consensus and flow timestamps

prediction.confidence_reason: Both inputs exist, but the Moomoo member surface is parked and raw flow has already failed as a standalone source.

candidates.reopen_condition: At least 20 independent timestamp-aligned candidate decisions with closed replacement values and a non-inert cash-conflict comparison.
candidates.next_machine_action: Do not reserve an experiment; quantify independent overlap and audit whether this is distinct from the parked Moomoo flow family.

candidates.title: Muted price response after a consensus revision
candidates.hypothesis: A timestamp-safe analyst estimate revision whose contemporaneous price-revealed response is unusually muted relative to its frozen calibration identifies underreaction that converges over H5-H20.

market_prior.provenance: Only bars known by the decision clock; OHLCV context is not claimed as a new source.

independent_evidence.provenance: Same-event revision ledger, independent of the price path used as prior.

expectation_gap.gap_definition: Frozen calibrated price response to a given consensus revision minus the observed response by the entry clock.

transmission.catalyst: Subsequent analyst dissemination or earnings confirmation closes the response gap.

candidates.why_not_arbitraged: The hypothesis requires exact revision clocks, same-event lineage, and a calibration conditioned on prior price response rather than a generic momentum filter.
candidates.falsifier: Date-shift and ticker-shuffle placebos match the exact mapping, or the effect disappears after the current core opportunity cost and canonical costs.

baseline.policy: Use current core candidates without the revision-response state.

treatment.policy: Admit one candidate per issuer clock only when the frozen revision-response gap is present.

candidates.replacement_value_comparator: Cash, SPY, QQQ, and the displaced core candidate on identical dates.

execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: same ADV and spread floor as current core
execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: default-off paper cap with one decision per issuer clock
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: next tradable session after revision and price-prior cutoff

prediction.confidence_reason: This uses an explicit expectation proxy and an existing independent revision surface, but both calibration and source readiness remain incomplete.

candidates.reopen_condition: At least 30 independent revision clocks, 10 tickers, and 10 actual core cash-conflict comparisons under a frozen calibration.
candidates.next_machine_action: Build an outcome-blind overlap and clock audit only; no return read and no experiment reservation.
